us-20261105-news-1.title: A Conta de Juros Chega ao Vencimento: Por Que os Pagamentos da Dívida de Washington Agora Rivalizam com Seus Maiores Itens Orçamentários

segments.src: For decades, interest on the national debt was a line item most Americans never thought about.
segments.tr: For decades, interest on the national debt was a line item most Americans never thought about.

segments.src: That is changing.
segments.tr: That is changing.

segments.src: Net interest, the amount the federal government pays on its borrowing after subtracting interest it earns, has climbed to roughly $1 trillion a year by recent estimates from the Congressional Budget Office (CBO) and the Treasury Department.
segments.tr: Net interest, the amount the federal government pays on its borrowing after subtracting interest it earns, has climbed to roughly $1 trillion a year by recent estimates from the Congressional Budget Office (CBO) and the Treasury Department.

segments.src: That puts it in the same league as Medicare and national defense, and well above many programs that dominate budget debates.
segments.tr: That puts it in the same league as Medicare and national defense, and well above many programs that dominate budget debates.

segments.src: This explainer walks through why the bill has grown, how it works, and what it could mean for budget negotiations, Treasury yields and long-term fiscal choices.
segments.tr: This explainer walks through why the bill has grown, how it works, and what it could mean for budget negotiations, Treasury yields and long-term fiscal choices.

segments.src: ## What "interest on the debt" actually means
segments.tr: ## What "interest on the debt" actually means

segments.src: The federal government borrows by selling Treasury securities: short-term bills, medium-term notes and long-term bonds.
segments.tr: The federal government borrows by selling Treasury securities: short-term bills, medium-term notes and long-term bonds.

segments.src: Investors, including pension funds, banks, foreign governments, mutual funds and individuals, buy them and receive interest payments.
segments.tr: Investors, including pension funds, banks, foreign governments, mutual funds and individuals, buy them and receive interest payments.

segments.src: Two figures are often mixed up:
segments.tr: Two figures are often mixed up:

segments.src: - **Gross interest** is everything the government pays on all outstanding debt, including debt held by other parts of the government, such as trust funds.
segments.tr: - **Gross interest** is everything the government pays on all outstanding debt, including debt held by other parts of the government, such as trust funds.

segments.src: - **Net interest** subtracts interest the government receives, and it is the figure most budget analysts track because it reflects the real claim on the budget.
segments.tr: - **Net interest** subtracts interest the government receives, and it is the figure most budget analysts track because it reflects the real claim on the budget.

segments.src: Either way, the number has grown quickly in recent years, both in dollars and as a share of the economy and of federal spending.
segments.tr: Either way, the number has grown quickly in recent years, both in dollars and as a share of the economy and of federal spending.

segments.src: ## Two forces behind the rise
segments.tr: ## Two forces behind the rise

segments.src: ### 1. A bigger pile of debt
segments.tr: ### 1. A bigger pile of debt

segments.src: Federal debt held by the public has grown substantially over the past two decades.
segments.tr: Federal debt held by the public has grown substantially over the past two decades.

segments.src: Recessions, the 2020 pandemic response, tax changes and the rising costs of an aging population have all contributed.
segments.tr: Recessions, the 2020 pandemic response, tax changes and the rising costs of an aging population have all contributed.

segments.src: Because the government has generally run annual deficits, new borrowing keeps adding to the base on which interest is charged.
segments.tr: Because the government has generally run annual deficits, new borrowing keeps adding to the base on which interest is charged.

segments.src: ### 2. Higher interest rates
segments.tr: ### 2. Higher interest rates

segments.src: For much of the 2010s, rates were historically low, so a large debt was relatively cheap to carry.
segments.tr: For much of the 2010s, rates were historically low, so a large debt was relatively cheap to carry.

segments.src: When inflation surged in 2022, the Federal Reserve raised its benchmark rate sharply, and yields across the Treasury market rose with it.
segments.tr: When inflation surged in 2022, the Federal Reserve raised its benchmark rate sharply, and yields across the Treasury market rose with it.

segments.src: The effect does not show up all at once.
segments.tr: The effect does not show up all at once.

segments.src: The Treasury continually refinances debt as older securities mature.
segments.tr: The Treasury continually refinances debt as older securities mature.

segments.src: A bond issued at a low rate years ago is eventually replaced by one at today's higher rate, so the average rate on the whole debt drifts upward gradually.
segments.tr: A bond issued at a low rate years ago is eventually replaced by one at today's higher rate, so the average rate on the whole debt drifts upward gradually.

segments.src: This is why interest costs can keep rising even after rates stop climbing.
segments.tr: This is why interest costs can keep rising even after rates stop climbing.

segments.src: Short-term bills are especially sensitive.
segments.tr: Short-term bills are especially sensitive.

segments.src: They roll over frequently, so changes in the Fed's policy rate feed through to the government's costs within months.
segments.tr: They roll over frequently, so changes in the Fed's policy rate feed through to the government's costs within months.

segments.src: ## How the numbers compare
segments.tr: ## How the numbers compare

segments.src: Net interest now exceeds what the government spends on national defense in several recent fiscal-year estimates, and it rivals or surpasses Medicaid and many other major categories.
segments.tr: Net interest now exceeds what the government spends on national defense in several recent fiscal-year estimates, and it rivals or surpasses Medicaid and many other major categories.

segments.src: The largest items, Social Security and Medicare, remain bigger.
segments.tr: The largest items, Social Security and Medicare, remain bigger.

segments.src: Still, interest differs from those programs in one important way: it is not a service Americans receive.
segments.tr: Still, interest differs from those programs in one important way: it is not a service Americans receive.

segments.src: It is the cost of past borrowing, and it cannot be cut through ordinary program reforms.
segments.tr: It is the cost of past borrowing, and it cannot be cut through ordinary program reforms.

segments.src: Exact rankings vary by year and by how spending is categorized, so it is worth checking the latest CBO and Treasury data when you read a headline comparison.
segments.tr: Exact rankings vary by year and by how spending is categorized, so it is worth checking the latest CBO and Treasury data when you read a headline comparison.

segments.src: ## Why it matters for budget fights
segments.tr: ## Why it matters for budget fights

segments.src: **Less room to maneuver.** Every dollar spent on interest is a dollar not available for roads, research, defense, health care or tax relief, unless it is financed by even more borrowing.
segments.tr: **Less room to maneuver.** Every dollar spent on interest is a dollar not available for roads, research, defense, health care or tax relief, unless it is financed by even more borrowing.

segments.src: Lawmakers negotiating annual spending bills increasingly work with a smaller pool of discretionary funds relative to the total.
segments.tr: Lawmakers negotiating annual spending bills increasingly work with a smaller pool of discretionary funds relative to the total.

segments.src: **A feedback loop.** Higher interest costs widen the deficit, which requires more borrowing, which adds to future interest costs.
segments.tr: **A feedback loop.** Higher interest costs widen the deficit, which requires more borrowing, which adds to future interest costs.

segments.src: Economists sometimes describe this as a compounding effect.
segments.tr: Economists sometimes describe this as a compounding effect.

segments.src: It is not inevitable, but it becomes harder to reverse as the debt grows relative to the economy.
segments.tr: It is not inevitable, but it becomes harder to reverse as the debt grows relative to the economy.

segments.src: **Political disagreement over the fix.** Analysts and policymakers differ on the response.
segments.tr: **Political disagreement over the fix.** Analysts and policymakers differ on the response.

segments.src: Some emphasize spending restraint, others favor raising revenue, and others stress faster economic growth.
segments.tr: Some emphasize spending restraint, others favor raising revenue, and others stress faster economic growth.

segments.src: Most nonpartisan analysts agree on one point: the arithmetic of rising interest costs makes the choices harder the longer they are postponed.
segments.tr: Most nonpartisan analysts agree on one point: the arithmetic of rising interest costs makes the choices harder the longer they are postponed.

segments.src: ## What it means for Treasury yields
segments.tr: ## What it means for Treasury yields

segments.src: Treasury yields are the prices the market sets for lending to the government.
segments.tr: Treasury yields are the prices the market sets for lending to the government.

segments.src: They respond to expectations about inflation, Fed policy, economic growth and the supply of new debt.
segments.tr: They respond to expectations about inflation, Fed policy, economic growth and the supply of new debt.

segments.src: When the government must sell large amounts of securities, investors may demand higher yields to absorb the supply, especially for longer maturities.
segments.tr: When the government must sell large amounts of securities, investors may demand higher yields to absorb the supply, especially for longer maturities.

segments.src: Debates over fiscal policy, debt-limit standoffs and credit-rating decisions can also move markets.
segments.tr: Debates over fiscal policy, debt-limit standoffs and credit-rating decisions can also move markets.

segments.src: Higher yields, in turn, raise the government's future borrowing costs, and they influence rates on mortgages, car loans and corporate debt.
segments.tr: Higher yields, in turn, raise the government's future borrowing costs, and they influence rates on mortgages, car loans and corporate debt.

segments.src: Yields are influenced by many factors at once, so it is hard to isolate the effect of any single one.
segments.tr: Yields are influenced by many factors at once, so it is hard to isolate the effect of any single one.

segments.src: Treat any single-cause explanation of a yield move with caution.
segments.tr: Treat any single-cause explanation of a yield move with caution.

segments.src: ## What it could mean for future taxes and services
segments.tr: ## What it could mean for future taxes and services

segments.src: Interest costs do not directly set tax policy, but they shape the options.
segments.tr: Interest costs do not directly set tax policy, but they shape the options.

segments.src: In broad terms, a government facing growing interest obligations can:
segments.tr: In broad terms, a government facing growing interest obligations can:

segments.src: 1. Raise revenue through taxes or fees.
segments.tr: 1. Raise revenue through taxes or fees.

segments.src: 2. Slow the growth of other spending.
segments.tr: 2. Slow the growth of other spending.

segments.src: 3. Borrow more and accept higher interest costs.
segments.tr: 3. Borrow more and accept higher interest costs.

segments.src: 4. Rely on stronger economic growth to expand the tax base.
segments.tr: 4. Rely on stronger economic growth to expand the tax base.

segments.src: In practice, governments usually use some mix.
segments.tr: In practice, governments usually use some mix.

segments.src: Which mix to choose is a political decision, and reasonable people disagree.
segments.tr: Which mix to choose is a political decision, and reasonable people disagree.

segments.src: What the numbers do show is that deferring the decision does not remove the cost.
segments.tr: What the numbers do show is that deferring the decision does not remove the cost.

segments.src: ## Key takeaways
segments.tr: ## Key takeaways

segments.src: - Net interest has become one of the largest federal budget categories, at roughly $1 trillion a year by recent estimates.
segments.tr: - Net interest has become one of the largest federal budget categories, at roughly $1 trillion a year by recent estimates.

segments.src: - The increase comes from both a larger debt and higher interest rates, with refinancing spreading the effect over several years.
segments.tr: - The increase comes from both a larger debt and higher interest rates, with refinancing spreading the effect over several years.

segments.src: - Interest spending is less flexible than most other parts of the budget.
segments.tr: - Interest spending is less flexible than most other parts of the budget.

segments.src: - Treasury yields, deficits and fiscal debates influence one another.
segments.tr: - Treasury yields, deficits and fiscal debates influence one another.

segments.src: - Future tax and spending choices will be made against this backdrop.
segments.tr: - Future tax and spending choices will be made against this backdrop.

segments.tr: ## Where to find reliable data

segments.tr: For current figures, consult primary sources: the Congressional Budget Office's budget and economic outlook, the Treasury Department's Monthly Treasury Statement and Fiscal Data site, and the Office of Management and Budget.

us-20261105-news-2.title: Prévia da Temporada de Impostos: Como as Novas Deduções de Gorjetas, Horas Extras e para Idosos Podem Moldar sua Declaração de 2026

segments.src: When filing season opens in early 2027, millions of taxpayers will meet several new lines on their returns.
segments.tr: Quando a temporada de declaração começar no início de 2027, milhões de contribuintes encontrarão várias novas linhas em suas declarações.

segments.src: The 2025 federal tax law, known as the One Big Beautiful Bill Act, created temporary deductions for qualified tip income, qualified overtime pay and older adults.
segments.tr: A lei tributária federal de 2025, conhecida como One Big Beautiful Bill Act, criou deduções temporárias para rendimentos qualificados de gorjetas, pagamento qualificado de horas extras e para adultos mais velhos.

segments.src: It also created one for interest on certain new auto loans.
segments.tr: Também criou uma para juros sobre certos novos empréstimos de automóveis.

segments.src: Some workers filed with these items for tax year 2025.
segments.tr: Alguns trabalhadores declararam esses itens no ano fiscal de 2025.

segments.src: For others, the 2026 return will be the first time they matter in a big way.
segments.tr: Para outros, a declaração de 2026 será a primeira vez que eles importarão de forma significativa.

segments.src: The details are specific, and the rules are easy to misread.
segments.tr: Os detalhes são específicos e as regras são fáceis de interpretar erroneamente.

segments.src: This guide explains who may qualify, what records are worth keeping now, and how paycheck withholding can change your refund.
segments.tr: Este guia explica quem pode se qualificar, quais registros vale a pena manter agora e como a retenção na fonte do contracheque pode alterar seu reembolso.

segments.src: *This article is general information, not tax advice.
segments.tr: *Este artigo é uma informação geral, não um conselho fiscal.

segments.src: Rules, forms and IRS guidance can change, so check current IRS materials or talk to a qualified tax professional about your own situation.*
segments.tr: Regras, formulários e orientações do IRS podem mudar, portanto, verifique os materiais atuais do IRS ou fale com um profissional tributário qualificado sobre sua própria situação.*

segments.src: ## The Big Picture: Deductions, Not Credits
segments.tr: ## O Panorama Geral: Deduções, Não Créditos

segments.src: These provisions are **deductions**, not credits.
segments.tr: Essas disposições são **deduções**, não créditos.

segments.src: A deduction lowers the income your tax is calculated on.
segments.tr: Uma dedução reduz a renda sobre a qual seu imposto é calculado.

segments.src: A credit lowers the tax itself, dollar for dollar.
segments.tr: Um crédito reduz o imposto em si, dólar por dólar.

segments.src: A $1,000 deduction therefore saves you roughly $100 to $370 in federal tax, depending on your tax bracket.
segments.tr: Portanto, uma dedução de $1.000 economiza aproximadamente de $100 a $370 em impostos federais, dependendo da sua faixa tributária.

segments.src: It does not save you $1,000.
segments.tr: Não economiza $1.000.

segments.src: Under the law, these deductions are generally available whether or not you itemize.
segments.tr: Pela lei, essas deduções estão geralmente disponíveis, independentemente de você detalhar ou não as despesas.

segments.src: You can usually claim them on top of the standard deduction.
segments.tr: Você geralmente pode reivindicá-las além da dedução padrão.

segments.src: They are scheduled to apply to tax years 2025 through 2028 unless Congress changes them.
segments.tr: Elas estão programadas para se aplicar aos anos fiscais de 2025 a 2028, a menos que o Congresso as altere.

segments.src: ## The Tips Deduction
segments.tr: ## A Dedução de Gorjetas

segments.src: **Who may qualify:** Workers who receive tips in an occupation that customarily and regularly received tips before 2025.
segments.tr: **Quem pode se qualificar:** Trabalhadores que recebem gorjetas em uma ocupação que costumeira e regularmente recebia gorjetas antes de 2025.

segments.src: The Treasury Department published a list of qualifying occupations.
segments.tr: O Departamento do Tesouro publicou uma lista de ocupações qualificadas.

segments.src: It includes jobs such as servers, bartenders, hotel workers, hair and beauty professionals, and delivery drivers.
segments.tr: Inclui empregos como garçons, bartenders, funcionários de hotel, profissionais de cabelo e beleza e motoristas de entrega.

segments.src: Check the current list for your job.
segments.tr: Verifique a lista atual para o seu trabalho.

segments.src: **Key points:**
segments.tr: **Pontos-chave:**

segments.src: - The deduction is capped at **$25,000** per return for qualified tips.
segments.tr: - A dedução é limitada a **$25.000** por declaração para gorjetas qualificadas.

segments.src: - The tips must be voluntary. A mandatory service charge added to a bill generally does not count.
segments.tr: - As gorjetas devem ser voluntárias. Uma taxa de serviço obrigatória adicionada a uma conta geralmente não conta.

segments.src: - The deduction begins to phase out when modified adjusted gross income (MAGI) exceeds roughly **$150,000** for single filers and **$300,000** for joint filers.
segments.tr: - A dedução começa a ser eliminada gradualmente quando a renda bruta ajustada modificada (MAGI) excede aproximadamente **$150.000** para declarantes solteiros e **$300.000** para declarantes conjuntos.

segments.src: - Self-employed people may qualify in some cases, but the deduction cannot exceed the net income from the business that earned the tips. Certain specified service trades or businesses are excluded.
segments.tr: - Pessoas autônomas podem se qualificar em alguns casos, mas a dedução não pode exceder a renda líquida do negócio que obteve as gorjetas. Certos comércios ou negócios de serviços especificados estão excluídos.

segments.src: - Married couples generally must file jointly to claim it, and a valid Social Security number is required.
segments.tr: - Casais casados geralmente devem declarar em conjunto para reivindicá-la, e um número de Seguro Social válido é necessário.

segments.src: - This deduction applies to federal income tax. Social Security and Medicare payroll taxes still apply to tips.
segments.tr: - Esta dedução aplica-se ao imposto de renda federal. Os impostos sobre a folha de pagamento da Previdência Social e do Medicare ainda se aplicam às gorjetas.

segments.src: ## The Overtime Deduction
segments.tr: ## A Dedução de Horas Extras

segments.src: **Who may qualify:** Employees who are paid overtime required under the Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA).
segments.tr: **Quem pode se qualificar:** Funcionários que recebem horas extras exigidas pela Lei de Normas Justas de Trabalho (FLSA).

segments.src: **Key points:**
segments.tr: **Pontos-chave:**

segments.src: - Only the "premium" portion of overtime counts. If you earn time-and-a-half, the deduction covers the extra half, not the full hourly rate for those hours.
segments.tr: - Apenas a parte "premium" das horas extras conta. Se você ganha hora e meia, a dedução cobre a metade extra, não a taxa horária total para essas horas.

segments.src: - The maximum deduction is **$12,500** for single filers and **$25,000** for joint filers.
segments.tr: - A dedução máxima é de **$12.500** para declarantes solteiros e **$25.000** para declarantes conjuntos.

segments.src: - The same MAGI phase-out thresholds apply as for tips (roughly $150,000 single, $300,000 joint).
segments.tr: - Aplicam-se os mesmos limites de eliminação gradual de MAGI que para gorjetas (aproximadamente $150.000 para solteiros, $300.000 para conjuntos).

segments.src: - Overtime paid under a union contract or company policy that goes beyond what the FLSA requires may not qualify.
segments.tr: - Horas extras pagas sob um contrato sindical ou política da empresa que vão além do que a FLSA exige podem não se qualificar.

segments.src: - A valid Social Security number is required, and married couples generally must file jointly.
segments.tr: - Um número de Seguro Social válido é necessário, e casais casados geralmente devem declarar em conjunto.

segments.src: ## The Senior Deduction
segments.tr: ## A Dedução para Idosos

segments.src: **Who may qualify:** Taxpayers who are age 65 or older by the end of the tax year.
segments.tr: **Quem pode se qualificar:** Contribuintes com 65 anos ou mais até o final do ano fiscal.

segments.src: **Key points:**
segments.tr: **Pontos-chave:**

segments.src: - The additional deduction is **$6,000 per eligible person**. A married couple where both spouses are 65 or older could claim up to $12,000.
segments.tr: - A dedução adicional é de **$6.000 por pessoa elegível**. Um casal casado onde ambos os cônjuges têm 65 anos ou mais pode reivindicar até $12.000.

segments.src: - It phases out at a rate of 6 cents per dollar of MAGI above about **$75,000** for single filers and **$150,000** for joint filers.
segments.tr: - Ela é eliminada gradualmente a uma taxa de 6 centavos por dólar de MAGI acima de cerca de **$75.000** para declarantes solteiros e **$150.000** para declarantes conjuntos.

segments.src: - It is separate from the existing additional standard deduction for people 65 and older, so the two can stack.
segments.tr: - É separada da dedução padrão adicional existente para pessoas com 65 anos ou mais, portanto, as duas podem ser acumuladas.

segments.src: - You must include a valid Social Security number for each person claimed.
segments.tr: - Você deve incluir um número de Seguro Social válido para cada pessoa reivindicada.

segments.src: ## Auto Loan Interest, Briefly
segments.tr: ## Juros de Empréstimo de Automóvel, Brevemente

segments.src: A related deduction covers up to **$10,000** of interest a year on a loan for a qualifying new vehicle.
segments.tr: Uma dedução relacionada cobre até **$10.000** de juros por ano em um empréstimo para um veículo novo qualificado.

segments.src: The vehicle must have final assembly in the United States, and the loan must have been taken out after 2024.
segments.tr: O veículo deve ter montagem final nos Estados Unidos, e o empréstimo deve ter sido feito após 2024.

segments.src: Income limits apply.
segments.tr: Limites de renda se aplicam.

segments.src: If you bought a car recently, keep your loan statements.
segments.tr: Se você comprou um carro recentemente, guarde seus extratos de empréstimo.

segments.src: ## Records to Keep Now
segments.tr: ## Registros para Manter Agora

segments.src: The best way to claim these deductions is to document your income as you earn it.
segments.tr: A melhor maneira de reivindicar essas deduções é documentar sua renda à medida que você a ganha.

segments.src: Consider these steps before the year ends:
segments.tr: Considere estas etapas antes que o ano termine:

segments.src: 1. **Tipped workers:** Keep a daily log of cash tips, plus card and app tips. Save statements from your employer's payroll or point-of-sale system. If you work through a delivery or rideshare platform, download your year-end earnings summaries.
segments.tr: 1. **Trabalhadores que recebem gorjetas:** Mantenha um registro diário de gorjetas em dinheiro, além de gorjetas em cartão e aplicativo. Salve extratos da folha de pagamento do seu empregador ou do sistema de ponto de venda. Se você trabalha através de uma plataforma de entrega ou transporte compartilhado, baixe seus resumos de ganhos de fim de ano.

segments.src: 2. **Overtime earners:** Keep your pay stubs. Make sure you can see regular hours, overtime hours and the overtime rate. Ask your payroll department how overtime is labeled.
segments.tr: 2. **Trabalhadores que recebem horas extras:** Guarde seus contracheques. Certifique-se de que você pode ver as horas regulares, horas extras e a taxa de horas extras. Pergunte ao seu departamento de folha de pagamento como as horas extras são rotuladas.

segments.src: 3. **Older adults:** Confirm your date of birth and Social Security number on all your tax records. If you are married, confirm the same for your spouse.
segments.tr: 3. **Adultos mais velhos:** Confirme sua data de nascimento e número de Seguro Social em todos os seus registros fiscais. Se você é casado, confirme o mesmo para seu cônjuge.

segments.src: 4. **Car buyers:** Save the loan agreement, the vehicle identification number (VIN) and interest statements.
segments.tr: 4. **Compradores de carros:** Salve o contrato de empréstimo, o número de identificação do veículo (VIN) e os extratos de juros.

segments.src: 5. **Everyone:** Look at your last pay stub of the year and compare it with the W-2 you receive in January. The IRS has been working with employers on new reporting. Expect separate reporting for qualified tips and overtime, but not every employer will have fully adapted. If your W-2 does not break out these amounts, you may need your own records to support the deduction.
segments.tr: 5. **Todos:** Olhe para o seu último contracheque do ano e compare-o com o W-2 que você recebe em janeiro. O IRS tem trabalhado com os empregadores em novos relatórios. Espere relatórios separados para gorjetas qualificadas e horas extras, mas nem todo empregador terá se adaptado totalmente. Se o seu W-2 não separar esses valores, você pode precisar de seus próprios registros para apoiar a dedução.

segments.src: ## How Withholding Could Affect Your Refund
segments.tr: ## Como a Retenção na Fonte Pode Afetar seu Reembolso

segments.src: Your refund is simply the difference between what was withheld from your pay during the year and what you actually owe.
segments.tr: Seu reembolso é simplesmente a diferença entre o que foi retido do seu pagamento durante o ano e o que você realmente deve.

segments.src: These new deductions reduce what you owe.
segments.tr: Essas novas deduções reduzem o que você deve.

segments.src: They do not automatically reduce what your employer withholds, unless you or your employer adjusts it.
segments.tr: Elas não reduzem automaticamente o que seu empregador retém, a menos que você ou seu empregador ajustem isso.

segments.src: - **If your withholding did not change,** you may be overpaying during the year and get a **larger refund** after you claim the deductions.
segments.tr: - **Se sua retenção não mudou,** você pode estar pagando a mais durante o ano e obter um **reembolso maior** após reivindicar as deduções.

segments.src: - **If you want more take-home pay now,** you can submit a new Form W-4 to your employer, using the deductions worksheet to account for the new deductions. The IRS Tax Withholding Estimator at IRS.gov can help you pick sensible numbers.
segments.tr: - **Se você quiser mais salário líquido agora,** você pode enviar um novo Formulário W-4 ao seu empregador, usando a planilha de deduções para contabilizar as novas deduções. O Estimador de Retenção de Impostos do IRS em IRS.gov pode ajudá-lo a escolher números sensatos.

segments.src: - **If you are self-employed or have income without withholding,** the deductions may reduce your quarterly estimated payments. Do not reduce them too far, though, because underpayment penalties can apply.
segments.tr: - **Se você é autônomo ou tem renda sem retenção na fonte,** as deduções podem reduzir seus pagamentos trimestrais estimados. Não os reduza demais, no entanto, porque penalidades por subpagamento podem ser aplicadas.

segments.src: - **Be careful about guessing.** Cutting withholding too much because you expect a deduction can leave you owing money in the spring. That is a risk if you hit the income phase-out, change jobs, or work fewer overtime hours than you expected.
segments.tr: - **Tenha cuidado ao adivinhar.** Cortar a retenção demais porque você espera uma dedução pode deixá-lo devendo dinheiro na primavera. Esse é um risco se você atingir a eliminação gradual de renda, mudar de emprego ou trabalhar menos horas extras do que esperava.

segments.src: A refund is not a bonus from the government.
segments.tr: Um reembolso não é um bônus do governo.

segments.src: It is your own money returned after the year ends.
segments.tr: É seu próprio dinheiro devolvido após o fim do ano.

segments.src: Deciding between a big refund and a bigger paycheck is a personal budgeting choice.
segments.tr: Decidir entre um grande reembolso e um salário maior é uma escolha de orçamento pessoal.

segments.src: ## Common Mistakes to Avoid
segments.tr: ## Erros Comuns a Evitar

segments.src: - **Assuming every overtime dollar is deductible.** Only the premium portion of FLSA-required overtime counts.
segments.tr: - **Assumir que cada dólar de hora extra é dedutível.** Apenas a parte premium das horas extras exigidas pela FLSA conta.

segments.src: - **Forgetting the income limits.** Higher earners may get a reduced deduction or none.
segments.tr: - **Esquecer os limites de renda.** Ganhadores mais altos podem obter uma dedução reduzida ou nenhuma.

segments.src: - **Filing separately as a married couple.** This can disqualify you from some of these deductions.
segments.tr: - **Declarar separadamente como um casal casado.** Isso pode desqualificá-lo de algumas dessas deduções.

segments.src: - **Claiming unreported tips without records.** The IRS may ask you to show how you arrived at the number.
segments.tr: - **Reivindicar gorjetas não declaradas sem registros.** O IRS pode pedir que você mostre como chegou ao número.

segments.src: - **Ignoring state taxes.** State rules differ. Some states follow the federal changes, while others do not.
segments.tr: - **Ignorar impostos estaduais.** As regras estaduais diferem. Alguns estados seguem as mudanças federais, enquanto outros não.

segments.src: ## What to Do Next
segments.tr: ## O Que Fazer a Seguir

segments.src: 1. Check whether your job appears on the IRS tipped-occupation list, or whether your overtime is FLSA-required.
segments.tr: 1. Verifique se o seu trabalho aparece na lista de ocupações com gorjetas do IRS, ou se suas horas extras são exigidas pela FLSA.

segments.src: 2. Estimate your MAGI to see whether phase-outs could apply.
segments.tr: 2. Estime seu MAGI para ver se as eliminações graduais podem se aplicar.

segments.src: 3. Run the IRS Tax Withholding Estimator and decide whether to adjust your W-4.
segments.tr: 3. Execute o Estimador de Retenção de Impostos do IRS e decida se deve ajustar seu W-4.

segments.src: 4. Organize your records into one folder, paper or digital, before January.
segments.tr: 4. Organize seus registros em uma pasta, física ou digital, antes de janeiro.

segments.src: 5. When filing, use reputable tax software or a licensed preparer, and compare the results against the official IRS instructions.
segments.tr: 5. Ao declarar, use um software tributário respeitável ou um preparador licenciado, e compare os resultados com as instruções oficiais do IRS.

segments.src: The new deductions can lower the tax bill for many workers and retirees, but they are not automatic and not unlimited.
segments.tr: As novas deduções podem reduzir a conta de impostos para muitos trabalhadores e aposentados, mas não são automáticas e não são ilimitadas.

segments.src: A little record-keeping in the coming weeks can make filing season go much more smoothly.
segments.tr: Um pouco de manutenção de registros nas próximas semanas pode tornar a temporada de declaração muito mais tranquila.

segments.tr: *Fontes para consultar: Orientação do IRS.gov sobre o One Big Beautiful Bill Act, as instruções do Formulário W-4 e o Estimador de Retenção de Impostos.
